Package org.example

Class Sub

java.lang.Object
org.example.Expression
org.example.Binary
org.example.Sub
public class Sub extends Binary
Represents the arithmetic subtraction operation of two expressions. This is a binary operation that extends the base Binary class.

    • derivative

      public Expression derivative(String var)
      Computes the derivative of the difference with respect to a given variable. According to calculus rules, the derivative of a difference is the difference of its derivatives: (f - g)' = f' - g'.
      Specified by:
      derivative in class Expression
      Parameters:
      var - the variable name with respect to which the differentiation is performed
      Returns:
      a new expression representing the derivative of this subtraction

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      Compares this subtraction expression with the specified object for equality. Two subtraction expressions are considered equal if both their left-hand and right-hand components are respectively equal.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Expression
      Parameters:
      obj - the object to be compared for equality with this expression
      Returns:
      true if the specified object is equal to this expression; false otherwise

    • simplify

      public Expression simplify()
      Performs algebraic simplification on this subtraction expression. The simplification process includes: Simplifying both the left-hand and right-hand operands. Checking for identity structural equality (if lhs is structurally equal to rhs, it immediately returns a Number of 0, even if the expressions contain unresolved variables like x - x). Constant folding (if both operands evaluate to pure numbers without throwing exceptions, a new Number object containing their difference is returned). If the expression contains unresolved variables and operands are not identical, the current subtraction object itself is returned with its operands simplified.
      Specified by:
      simplify in class Expression
      Returns:
      a simplified mathematical expression
